This might have been the only [[QuakeWorld]] tournament in history that didn't feature a single WalkOver during the group games. Sad enough, {{Flag/us}} [[The Boss]] got two of them in the playoffs, making them win the tournament without even playing a game after the regular season. 

The semi-final that did get played, between {{Flag/us}} [[5 angry men]] (former [[Massacre @ Chicago Smooth|m@cs]]) and {{Flag/us}} [[Confederacy]] was highly controversial because even though {{Flag/us}} [[Confederacy]] had enough players they decided to play with a non listed player named [[fore]] who nobody had seen before. Because {{Flag/us}} [[5 angry men|5am]] just wanted to play they agreed and [[fore]] turned out to be a key player for {{Flag/us}} [[Confederacy]]'s victory. Strangly, after this they did not play the final with {{Flag/us}} [[The Boss]], leaving them the title uncontested.

The map pool consisted of TB3: [[DM2]], [[DM3]] and [[E1M2]]. The group games were played in a BO3 and the playoffs BO5.
